full_judgment: 2. The suit land originally belonged to one Abdul Aziz Miah. The plaintiff claimed in the plaint that his father Ismail Miah took permanent settlement of the land at an annual rental of Taka 4.00 in the year 1346 BS on the basis of farog which was granted under the signature of Aminullah, the son of the landlord, in favour of the plaintiff. The plaintiff has been in possession of the land on payment of rent to the landlord upto 1361 BS by cultivating the land. During the revisional settlement operation at the initial stage the name of the plaintiff was recorded in respect of the land but subsequently the defendants collusively got the land recorded in their names though they have no right, title and interest. The plaintiff brought Misc. case in the Court of Subordinate Judge for correcting the record of rights. The plaintiff has discovered a pillar from beneath the earth in which his name is engraved. This establishes the title of the plaintiff.
